# @hivemind/view-sdk (vendored)

A copy of the view SDK that Hivemind 2026.10.8 serves to views and live wallpapers, from
[dip497/hivemind](https://github.com/dip497/hivemind/tree/main/packages/hive-view-sdk) (MIT, © the hivemind
contributors). Hivescape only type-checks and tests against it: a built wallpaper leaves
`@hivemind/view-sdk` external, and the app serves its own copy at run time.

Update it with the copy in dip497/hivemind-plugins (`types/view-sdk`), which tracks the released app.
